senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טָעָה, טַעֲיָיא , a. Ges. H. Dict.10 s. v. צען) [to move, make ready for travelling,]

units: Num. R. s. 6 וטוֹעֲנִים על העגלות and pack (them) upon wagons; a. fr.—Part. pass. טָעוּן (interch. with טוֹעֵן) laden, carrying.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5">Ib. s. 5</cite> <he>מי שהוא ט׳ בקרשים</he> some had a share in carrying (moving) the boards.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:8">Ib.</cite> <he>טוענין כל כלי האריגה</he> had to carry all woven materials.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 6:2">Ib. s. 6</cite> <he>היה מִטּוֹעֲנֵי וכ׳</he> was one of those carrying the ark.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 32b:10">B. Mets. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>טְעוּנָה יין אסור</he> carrying forbidden wine.—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:5-14">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII</cite> <he>בשעה … טְעוּנִין את המים</he> when the clouds are charged with water; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 160:2">Yalk. Sam. 160</cite> <he>טוענין מן המים</he> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="H01847"><he>חָשַׁךְ</he></cite>.
Ib. אלו טוענין חרבות וכ׳ those carrying swords, others lances &c.; a. fr.—3) Esp. to help one broken down on the road to load again, contrad. to פרק to help in unloading.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:10">B. Mets. II, 10</cite> <he>מצוה לִטְעוֹן …</he> the biblical law requires man to help in unloading, but not in loading (without remuneration); <he>אף לט׳</he> loading, too, must be done gratuitously, v. <cite ref="I00607"><he>טְעִינָה</he></cite>; a. fr.
Gen. R. s. 82 נ׳ ברכות was laden with blessings; a. e.—Trnsf. (cmp. כָּבֵד) to be very ill.
<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 8:7">Treat. S’maḥ. ch. VIII</cite> <he>אמר לו נ׳</he> he said to him, He (thy son) is very ill.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 87">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXXVII</cite> [read:) <he>אינן יכולין להִטָּעֵן … וטוֹעֲנִין וכ׳</he> who cannot be carried (on wagons &c.) … and they carry them on their hands (in a chair); (v. <cite ref="I00617">next w.</cite> a.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13">Lev. R. s. 13</cite> <he>ה׳ לחמורו וכ׳</he> he put on his ass five S’ah &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 5a:17">Sabb. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>הִטְעִינוֹ חבירו</he> his neighbor placed something in his hand to carry, <he>ה׳ שמים</he> the heavens placed &c. (when he put his hand forth to collect and carry rain water); a. e.

senses.gloss: to carry goods for sale. Y. Peah I, 16ᵃ top (ref. to Lev. XIX, 16) שלא תהא כרוכל הזה מַטְעִין דבריו וכ׳ be not like the peddler carrying the talk of this one to the other &c.
